# Number

Number Input is a single-lined field where you can enter a number. Its also shows up and down arrows to change the value as provided by HTML number input rendered in browser.

:::note
The following examples use a field named `number_field`. This should be replaced with your field name.
:::

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.number_field }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->number_field }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

## Parameters

<Tabs groupId="template-language">
<TabItem value="twig" label="Twig">

```twig
{{ entry.number_field.parameters({decimal_places: 2}) }}
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="blade" label="Blade">

```php
{{ $entry->number_field->parameters(['decimal_places' => 2]) }}
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>

:::info
See the ExpressionEngine Documentation for more information on the [Number fieldtype](https://docs.expressionengine.com/latest/fieldtypes/number.html)
:::
